title: Moment-based approximation of cell and face integrals in THINC/QQ reconstruction on unstructured grids
summary: On unstructured grids, the tangent of hyperbola for interface capturing (THINC) method with quadratic surface representation and Gaussian quadrature (THINC/QQ) requires topology-dependent numerical quadrature for cell and face integrals and Newton iteration for the surface constant. This study introduces a quadratic moment-matched sigmoid (QMMS) approximation that evaluates these quantities from the mean and variance of the quadratic field while retaining the hyperbolic-tangent reconstruction profile and the boundary variation diminishing (BVD) formulation.
